title: Hierarchical Dual-Graph Retrieval for Long-form Audio Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio language models (LALMs) struggle with long-form audio reasoning, as processing entire recordings often limits to capture query-relevant content distributed across distant segments while incurring substantial computational cost. We introduce AudioHelix, a hierarchical DualGraph framework tailored for LALMs' retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. Unlike existing text-only or non-graph RAG approaches, AudioHelix connects related textual and acoustic evidence across temporally distant segments for multi-hop reasoning. Extensive experiments on TraceAV-Bench, MMAU-Pro, and AudioMarathon demonstrate that AudioHelix consistently outperforms full-audio processing and existing RAG methods. The project site is https://github.com/ewha-mmai/audiohelix.

translated_title: 面向长音频推理的层次化双图检索
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在长音频推理方面存在困难，因为处理完整录音往往难以捕捉分布在相距较远片段中的与查询相关的内容，同时还会带来巨大的计算开销。我们提出了 AudioHelix，一个为大型音频语言模型的检索增强生成（RAG）系统量身定制的层次化双图（DualGraph）框架。与现有的纯文本或非图结构的 RAG 方法不同，AudioHelix 能够将时间上相距较远的片段中相关的文本与声学证据连接起来，从而实现多跳推理。在 TraceAV-Bench、MMAU-Pro 和 AudioMarathon 上进行的大量实验表明，AudioHelix 的表现始终优于全音频处理方式及现有的 RAG 方法。项目网站为 https://github.com/ewha-mmai/audiohelix。
tldr: AudioHelix 是一个为大型音频语言模型设计的层次化双图 RAG 框架，通过连接时间上相距较远片段中的文本与声学证据实现多跳推理，在长音频推理任务上持续超越全音频处理和现有 RAG 方法。
en_tdlr: AudioHelix is a hierarchical dual-graph RAG framework for large audio language models that connects textual and acoustic evidence across temporally distant segments for multi-hop reasoning, consistently outperforming full-audio processing and existing RAG methods on long-form audio reasoning tasks.
